faq.heading: Before you ask — the answers are here
faq.sub: The questions most likely to stop you before ordering, answered plainly.

items.a: An AI automation system for producing short videos and publishing them regularly, together with a setup walkthrough and bonuses to help you start.

items.q: What does the system do on its own?
items.a: It helps generate the idea, prepare the video content, write the title, caption and hashtags, and organise publishing according to your settings.

items.q: Do the videos come out ready to publish?
items.a: Yes — the goal is short videos ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, which you can still review or edit before they go out.

items.q: Can I use it from my phone?
items.a: Yes. The system runs in the cloud, so a normal phone is enough to operate and monitor it.

items.q: Do I need a powerful computer?
items.a: No. The heavy processing does not depend on your hardware, so no expensive machine or graphics card is required.

items.q: Do I need experience with AI or video editing?
items.a: No. The walkthrough is written for a complete beginner, step by step, with no technical background assumed.

items.q: Do I have to show my face or film myself?
items.a: No. The system is built for faceless content — no personal filming and no on-camera appearance.

items.q: Can I work across more than one platform?
items.a: Yes. The same short-form content can be used on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts depending on your plan and accounts.
No. There is no guarantee of any income. Results depend on consistency, niche, how you use the system, and factors outside it entirely.

items.q: What if I am a complete beginner?
items.a: It suits you, because it includes the setup walkthrough, a Quick Start, and a content plan to get you moving from zero.
No. It is a one-time payment with no recurring subscription.
Yes, direct technical support is available to help you understand the setup and resolve basic problems.

items.q: How is this different from making videos manually?
items.a: Doing it by hand costs time and effort every single day. The system shortens the thinking, preparation, and publishing steps so you can keep going.

items.q: Is there a plan to follow after I buy?
items.a: Yes. The bonuses include a 30-Day Auto Content Plan and the AI Page Launch Kit so your first month has clear steps.
